P14.formalLineDefinition:
CREATE TABLE `com_sales_order_line` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '主键ID',
  `tenant_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '租户ID',
  `order_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '订单ID',
  `source_system` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '父订单来源系统',
  `source_record_key` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `source_version` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `company_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '父订单所属公司主档ID',
  `company_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '公司编码',
  `company_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '公司名称',
  `order_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '父订单类型编码',
  `order_no` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '父订单编号',
  `line_no` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '行编号',
  `line_type` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '行类型编码',
  `product_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品编码/物料编码（ERP订单行）',
  `product_model` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品型号/物料型号（原model_code）',
  `product_desc` varchar(512) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品描述/物料描述（原item_desc）',
  `custom_info` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源customInfo原样同步',
  `product_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '产品ID',
  `bundle_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '套件编码',
  `profit_center` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '利润中心',
  `real_execution_no` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '实际执行单编号',
  `warranty_month` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '质保期限月数',
  `customer_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '父订单客户主档ID',
  `customer_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户编码',
  `customer_name` varchar(512) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户名称',
  `order_qty` decimal(18,6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ERP订单行下单数量',
  `open_qty` decimal(18,6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ERP订单行当前未执行数量',
  `delivered_qty` decimal(18,6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ERP订单行当前累计发货数量',
  `unit_code` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `unit_scale` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `quantity_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `source_lifecycle_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `source_sync_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '来源同步时间',
  `source_updated_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '状态',
  `version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '乐观锁版本',
  `creator` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '创建人',
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updater` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '更新人',
  `update_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '删除标志：0否，1是',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_sales_order_line_tenant_row` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_sales_order_line_source` (`tenant_id`,`source_system`,`source_record_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_sales_order_line_business` (`tenant_id`,`source_system`,`company_code`,`line_type`,`order_no`,`line_no`),
  KEY `idx_sales_order_line_business` (`tenant_id`,`source_system`,`company_code`,`order_type`,`order_no`,`line_no`),
  KEY `idx_sales_order_line_customer` (`tenant_id`,`customer_code`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_sales_order_line_profit` (`tenant_id`,`profit_center`,`order_id`),
  KEY `idx_sales_order_line_product` (`tenant_id`,`product_code`),
  KEY `idx_sales_order_line_parent` (`tenant_id`,`order_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_sales_order_line_order` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `order_id`) REFERENCES `com_sales_order` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_sales_order_line_authority` CHECK (((`quantity_status` <> _utf8mb4'CONFIRMED') or (`order_qty` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_sales_order_line_deleted` CHECK ((`deleted` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_sales_order_line_known_unit` CHECK (((`quantity_status` = _utf8mb4'PENDING_AUTHORITY') or (`unit_code` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_sales_order_line_quantity_scale` CHECK ((((`order_qty` is null) or (round(`order_qty`,`unit_scale`) = `order_qty`)) and ((`open_qty` is null) or (round(`open_qty`,`unit_scale`) = `open_qty`)) and ((`delivered_qty` is null) or (round(`delivered_qty`,`unit_scale`) = `delivered_qty`)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_sales_order_line_source_lifecycle` CHECK ((`source_lifecycle_status` in (_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED',_utf8mb4'RETURNED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_sales_order_line_unit_scale` CHECK ((`unit_scale` between 0 and 6))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='ERP销售订单行及数量快照'

P31.sourceScopeSql:
SELECT CAST(p.projectId AS CHAR) AS source_key,chosen.projectId AS project_id,p.projectType AS project_type,
           p.projectCode AS original_project_code,current_project.projectCode AS project_code,NULL AS fingerprint
    FROM pm_project p
    JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId
          FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen
      ON chosen.typeKey=CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY) AND chosen.codeKey=CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY)
    JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=chosen.projectId
    WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.disabled=0
      AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.projectType='10'
    ORDER BY p.projectId LIMIT 1000001
